definition: Xiaomi MiMo is a family of large language models (LLMs) developed by Xiaomi.
details: It was initially released in April 2025 with the MiMo-7B model. Currently, MiMo is available for developers through API service. It is used as the key AI model in Xiaomi's "Human x Car x Home" ecosystem.

explainer.lead: Xiaomi MiMo is a family of large language models developed by Xiaomi, first released in April 2025 with MiMo-7B. It matters because it is the key AI model in Xiaomi's "Human x Car x Home" ecosystem.

tiers.eli5: It is Xiaomi's own homegrown AI brain, built to connect its phones, cars and smart home devices.
tiers.practitioner: Developers access MiMo through an API service rather than training it themselves. The pitfall is dependency on a single vendor's ecosystem and API terms.
tiers.paperLevel: A family of large language models, beginning with a 7-billion-parameter model (MiMo-7B), offered as a hosted API. The available details do not specify training data or architecture beyond the model size.

explainer.example: A developer building a smart-home assistant calls the MiMo API instead of hosting a model, letting Xiaomi's service handle inference.

usedIn.name: Xiaomi Human x Car x Home
